newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket rises $1.08 to $22.38 in wk.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket rises $1.08 to $22.38 in wk.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and products rose $1.08 to $22.38 on Friday, compared to $21.30 on Oct 11, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
The average price for the year so far is $17.60 per barrel, the ministry statement said.
Venezuela's oil export price averaged $14.84 per barrel last year compared to $13.23 per barrel in 1994.
Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta told reporters Friday he expected Venezuela's oil price to fluctuate between $21 and $22 per barrel for the rest of the year.
The Venezuelan government has based its recently revised 1996 budget calculations on an average price of $17.20 per barrel.
